final: WITH g AS (SELECT c.location AS city, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM qualifying q JOIN races r ON r.raceId = q.raceId JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY c.location), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM g WHERE cnt IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(g.cnt) AS avg_kept_count, AVG(g.cnt - a.avg_cnt) AS avg_diff FROM g JOIN a ON a.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL WHERE g.cnt > a.avg_cnt
